caption:
Large Sahab’s whisky trail: India makes world-class single malt. 🥃

Amrut from Bengaluru. Paul John from Goa. Rampur from Uttar Pradesh. Indri from Haryana. Godawan from Rajasthan.

Which one have you tried? And which state should be next on the trail?

Sip slowly. Never drink and drive.

#IndianSingleMalt #LargeSahab #EkLarge #MadeInIndia
